successCriteria.description: src/shared/types/leave.ts exports a LeaveType enum with exactly three string-valued members: ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY
src/shared/types/leave.ts exports a LeaveRequestStatus enum with exactly five string-valued members: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED
src/shared/types/leave.ts exports a BalanceStatus enum with exactly three string-valued members: ACTIVE, EXHAUSTED, FROZEN
src/shared/types/index.ts barrel re-exports all three enums (LeaveType, LeaveRequestStatus, BalanceStatus) from ./leave
Jest unit tests in tests/unit/shared/types/ verify each enum has the correct members and correct member count

constraints: Enums must use string-valued members (e.g., ANNUAL = 'ANNUAL'), not numeric — consistent with TypeScript strict mode and serialization needs
All TypeScript files must pass tsc --noEmit under strict mode (no implicit any, strict null checks)
Barrel export pattern: src/shared/types/index.ts re-exports all public symbols from leave.ts; consumers import from the barrel, not from leave.ts directly
outOfScope: LeaveType members beyond ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY (e.g., UNPAID, MATERNITY, PATERNITY) — deferred to later phases
Any model, repository, service, controller, route, or migration code — this phase is types-only foundation
State transition rules, business logic, or validation — enums are pure data definitions with no behaviour
